About.title: About SYSMAR
About.subtitle: Smart management for the Faculty of Marine Sciences.
About.whatIsDesc: SYSMAR is an academic and administrative management platform developed for the Faculty of Marine Sciences of the Universidad Católica del Norte. Its main objective is to centralize and optimize the administration of laboratories, vehicles, and student tracking, connecting the entire community in a single collaborative environment.

transparency.title: Traceability
transparency.desc: Detailed historical record of all academic activities and resource reservations.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.desc: Optimization in requesting laboratories and vehicles for field trips.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.desc: Unified tools for teachers, students, and researchers of the FCM.

FCM.title: Faculty of Marine Sciences
FCM.subtitle: Universidad Católica del Norte
FCM.whoAreWeDesc: The Faculty of Marine Sciences of UCN, Coquimbo campus, is a pioneering academic unit dedicated to the study, research, and conservation of marine resources and ecosystems. We train professionals of excellence, contributing to sustainable development through science, teaching, and community outreach.
